svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 1,174 mm lengths of 50 x 40 x 3 tube, 40 mm side up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Post bolt holes, 9 mm through both walls, two at each post, 40 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart: centred 547 mm (front post) and 954 mm (rear post) from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End clamp holes, 9 mm in the top wall, 10 mm from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap both ends with plastic tube caps.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the rails run up the slope at 460 mm each side of the centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm past the panel's front and back edges; the panel frame

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sits on them and four solar end clamps hold its front and back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edges. The slope is 10 degrees, high at the street side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both rails in one plane (string line across the tops).
